tool_input.content:
version: 2
models:
  - name: raw_security_master
    description: "Raw security master reference data. Comprehensive security attributes sourced from the seed_security_master CSV. One row per security (ticker)."
    config:
      domain: 'Security'
    columns:
      - name: record_pk
        description: "MD5 surrogate key from ticker"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: ticker
        description: "Ticker symbol (natural key)"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: cusip
        description: "CUSIP identifier"
      - name: change_key
        description: "MD5 hash of business columns for SCD2 change detection"
        tests: [not_null]
